subject: Request: SLA remediation & concession for Greenline outage
messages:
From: Chris Turner <chris.turner@greenline.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request for SLA remediation and credit - Greenline account

Hi team,

Quick summary: on 2026-08-04 between 02:22 and 05:10 UTC our production traffic to the Redwood inference endpoint for model text-embed-003 experienced elevated latency and several 503s. Our monitoring flags this as a breach of the 99.9% latency SLO for that route. This impacted our search relevance pipelines and caused a visible customer incident.

We need two things:
- A short incident summary and RC (root cause) document for our audit (SOC/contract).
- A remediation concession: Greenline is asking for either a one-month suspension of usage charges for August or a custom credit equal to 20% of our August forecasted usage, plus expedited prioritization on the remediation plan.

Please confirm next steps and whether Redwood can provide a formal credit calculation and a templated amendment we can sign. We have procurement on copy (procurement@greenline.ai) and will need an executed amendment before we approve any credit acceptance.

Thanks,
Chris Turner\Head of Platform Reliability\Greenline AI
[attachment: greenline_incident_log_snippet.txt (txt)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request for SLA remediation and credit - Greenline account

Marissa / Marcus — looping you in. Greenline (GL-2024-07-119) reported a 2.8-hour incident that looks like an SLO breach for their embedding route. They are requesting either one free month or a 20% usage credit for August, plus a signed amendment. Revenue at stake: Greenline is currently ~ $58k/mo committed usage (hosted).

My assessment: the incident was caused by a transient autoscaler misconfiguration on a new GPU pool plus a downstream network flapping event; ops has a remediation plan (attached). Proposed offers to present to customer (ranked):
1) One month free of hosted charges for August + expedited remediation and a postmortem + remediation milestones in an amendment.
2) A 15% usage credit for August + the same remediation commitments.
3) 40k credits (tokens) plus an ops review call + remediation SLO in amendment.

Asking for delegated approval: Marcus, what limit do we have for credits without executive signoff? Marissa, if we need exec sign-off, recommend we approve option 2 as a standard concession and reserve option 1 for special exec approval.

Attachments: remediation_plan_v1.docx, greenline_incident_summary.pdf

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 12:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for SLA remediation and credit - Greenline account

Karthik — thanks for the summary. A few clarifying items I need before we approve anything:
- Exact dollar value for option 1 & 2 (we need $ amount to check against delegated approval thresholds).
- Confirmation the customer has not already been offered overlapping credits in the last 6 months. (Quick check says no prior credits in the last 6 months.)
- Confirmation that remediation milestones will be tracked in the Console with observable checkpoints (we need telemetry hooks for audit).

Delegation: Finance can approve up to $12,500 in one-off credits without VP signoff. Anything above that requires VP Sales sign-off and a record in Salesforce. If this is >$12.5k, get Marissa to sign off and CC Legal for an amendment template.

Also: please attach the usage forecast or August invoice estimate so I can compute the percent credit.

Marcus
Director, Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example>, Legal <legal@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for SLA remediation and credit - Greenline account

Thanks for flagging. I reviewed the incident summary and forecast. Given the duration and customer impact, I approve the following concession to present to Greenline:

Approved concession (conditional):
- One-time concession equal to 15% of Greenline's August forecasted hosted charges (approx $8.7k based on provided forecast).
- Redwood will include a one-month priority remediation channel (ops on-call guaranteed response SLA for the next 30 days) and commit to the attached remediation milestones.
- The concession is contingent on a signed amendment that includes the remediation milestones and a clause that limits recurring credits (i.e., a one-off remediation concession).

Notes:
- We will not offer a free full month for >$20k without exec committee sign-off.
- Marcus: please prepare the accounting entry and confirm the impact to monthly MRR/ARR recognition.
- Legal: please draft an amendment (DocuSign) that covers the remediation milestones and the concession language. Monica, coordinate the reach-back with procurement.

Marissa
VP Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
To: Chris Turner <chris.turner@greenline.ai>, Maya Singh <procurement@greenline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for SLA remediation and credit - Greenline account

Hi Chris / Maya — thanks for the details and for your patience while we reviewed this internally.

Redwood's offer (approved by our Sales leadership):
- A one-time concession equal to 15% of your August hosted charges (we estimate ~$8.7k based on the forecast you provided).
- A one-month priority remediation channel with guaranteed ops response windows and weekly checkpoint calls.
- We will provide a concise incident summary and the remediation plan.

Next steps:
1) Legal will send an amendment for signature (DocuSign link to follow). Please confirm the procurement contact (Maya?) and the billing entity for the amendment.
2) We will attach the official incident summary and remediation plan once the amendment is in motion.

Attachments: greenline_incident_summary.pdf (summary), remediation_plan_v1.docx (ops plan).

If you need a different structure (e.g., token credits instead of percentage), let me know and we can propose an alternate.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Chris Turner <chris.turner@greenline.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Cc: Maya Singh <procurement@greenline.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for SLA remediation and credit - Greenline account

Karthik / Marissa — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear commitment. Greenline accepts the 15% concession and the remediation milestone commitments.

Procurement contact is Maya Singh (procurement@greenline.ai). Please send the DocuSign amendment and we'll loop in our legal. We will need the concession reflected on our August invoice or as a separate credit memo.

Thanks,
Chris
Head of Platform Reliability — Greenline AI
